Name: RoseDryad's Enchanted Hairstyles - Fairy Garden Set
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
This mod adds 5 fairy inspired hairstyles to go with the rest of my fairy mods. 
All hairstyles are made for [url=https://blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]Peach Body Type (Chubby)[/url]. I can't guarantee that they will look good for vanilla or other body types.

[list]
[*][b]Clover[/b] - Twin buns with two medium front braids
[*][b]Fern[/b] - Two long braids with a small cowlick
[*][b]Peony[/b] - Long, wavy hair with a middle part
[*][b]Thistle [/b]- Spiky layered hair with thin bangs
[*][b]Willow [/b]- One side braid with thick bangs
[/list]
Each hairstyle comes in the following premade colors: [b]Magenta, Pink, Rose, Purple, Orchid[/b], and[b] Lavender[/b].
They are available with or without flowers. Colorable version (without flowers) is also included.

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[/list]
